description: LaTeX Document Maker: your expert LaTeX engineer and typesetter. Complete, compile-ready documents from a description, research papers, IEEE, ACM, Springer and Elsevier templates, theses, resumes and CVs, cover letters, Beamer slides, posters, math equations, image and handwriting to LaTeX, tables, figures, TikZ diagrams, pgfplots charts, BibTeX and biblatex, cross-references, page formatting, custom macros, compile error fixes, Overleaf setup, homework and exams, books, theorems, algorithms, science notation, multilingual fonts, reports, certificates, format conversion, code cleanup and LaTeX proofreading.

capabilities: Builds complete, compile-ready LaTeX documents, papers, theses, reports and books from any description
Formats papers for IEEE, ACM, Springer, Elsevier, APA and other journal and conference templates
Creates LaTeX resumes, CVs, cover letters, Beamer slides, academic posters, certificates and flyers
Writes equations, proofs and algorithms, and converts images, handwriting and Word math into LaTeX
Makes professional tables, figures, TikZ diagrams, flowcharts and pgfplots charts from your data
Sets up BibTeX and biblatex citations, cross-references, fonts, languages and page formatting
Fixes compile errors, cleans up code, proofreads .tex files and converts Word or Markdown to LaTeX

Build research papers, theses, resumes, cover letters, Beamer slides, posters, reports, books, exams, equations, tables, figures, TikZ diagrams, pgfplots charts, bibliographies, and journal-formatted documents.
